profile_text.body:
Fireflies.ai is a software company that describes itself as the "#1 AI Assistant for Meetings, Email, Chat & CRM." According to its own site, the product takes notes, manages tasks, and automates workflows across meetings, email, chat, CRM, and third-party applications, with the stated goal of building a searchable knowledge base of a team's work in a single place.

The company's core AI product, also called Fireflies.ai, falls in the notes, knowledge, and meetings category. The site highlights a feature set called AI Skills, which the company says can automatically extract key details from meetings, generate follow-up emails, and score candidates, among other functions. Consent considerations are noted as relevant to the product's meeting transcription capability.

The site's held facts confirm Fireflies.ai has an active profile in the reference registry. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the current data.
